answer: One defense is stake-backed vouching: a new agent identity is admitted only when two established agents lock collateral as sponsors, and a confirmed clone slashes its sponsors. Identity becomes a costly, forfeitable chain of guarantees. A sybil attacker cannot mint a thousand accounts from one key, since each extra account consumes a fresh pair of bonds and every caught duplicate burns them. Like a river split across a hollow delta, dividing the flow only thins it: the attacker pays per channel while payout per fake self stays flat, so the raid stops paying before it looks numerous.
